To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the use of a field network in the control system for injection presses is a feasible and effective solution, which is also cost-competitive.

the adoption of a fieldbus network for the control system of a plastic material injection press is a viable solution that enables a dramatic decrease of both cabling complexity and costs, together with an improvement in the performance and reliability of the whole system.

the adoption of field networks to connect sensors and actuator to the controller is a feasible solution, that the use of field networks in the design of the control system is an effective way to improve performance, that the adoption of fieldbuses in the design of control systems is a cost effective way to reduce the complexity of cabling.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a new control system for a plastic injection molding press that can be used to produce washing machines tubs.
a novel approach to the design of a distributed control system for the injection presses, which is characterized by the adoption of a fieldbus architecture to connect sensors and controllers.
the design and implementation of a control system for a press for plastic material injection, which relies on a distributed architecture and on fieldbus communications.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the field network approach is a valid alternative to traditional solutions for the design of a new generation control system for plastic material injection presses.
the field network is a viable solution for the implementation of distributed control systems for the press.
the adoption of field networks for the implementation of a new generation presses for plastic material injections is technically feasible, cost-effective, and reliable.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a fieldbus system is a viable solution to implement a control system in the plastic material injection presses.
the adoption of the fieldbus solution is feasible and that the results are encouraging.
the field network is an effective way to connect intelligent devices to the press control equipment.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the use of a fieldbus to connect sensors and controllers in the control system of a plastic injection machine is feasible, provided that the communication protocol used is suitable for the specific application and the network is carefully designed.
the adoption of fieldbuses in the control of injection presses is feasible and can be implemented in a cost effective way.
a fieldbus solution is a viable and effective way to improve the control of the injection presses.
